title: A pack-label photo logs the whole pack by default and never asks
replays: The 2 Nov class: a pack label photo was logged, then the owner was asked did you eat the whole pack? The rule is a whole-pack default, said in one line, never a question.

steps.text: Here is a photo of the label on my protein bar pack: 220 kcal per bar, 4 bars in the pack. Logging my snack.
